itineraries.summary: A 3-day day-by-day itinerary for Split and surroundings posted by the creator on TikTok. Day 1 covers Split Old Town (Riva coffee, Diocletian's Palace and the Peristyle, Old Town alleys, Marjan Hill at sunset, seafood dinner at a local konoba). Day 2 is island hopping to Hvar and Brac with a full-day speedboat tour from Split, swims in hidden coves, a dip at the Pakleni Islands, and lunch in Hvar town plus its old town and fortress. Day 3 is an adventure day in Omis: zipline over the Cetina River canyon, white-water rafting or canyoning, a stroll through Omis Old Town with a riverside lunch, then back to Split for a relaxed final evening.
itineraries.title: 3 Days in Split, Croatia - The Perfect Itinerary
